title: (a) If a person is guilty of any offence
text:
79.

(a) If a person is guilty of any offence
specified in sub-section (1) of section 233;

(b) If a person contravenes sub-section (2)
of section 233.

233(1)

233(2)

237(1),
237(2)

The person concerned
shall be liable to fine
which may extend to
fifty rupees; but this
liability shall not

prejudice the recovery of
the fare, if any, payable
by him;

Fine which may extend
to three hundred rupees. .

The master-owner or

agent shall be liable to
fine which may extend to
one thousand rupees.
